assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 221% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 222 cases per week in the latest week.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 685% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 71 cases per week in the latest week.
US flu hospital admissions are rising with a 58% increase over the previous month, reaching 9,619 cases in the latest week.
Mpox cases in the US are rising with a 72% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 48 cases per week in the latest week.
Polio Wikipedia readership is at the 97th percentile of the past year, indicating heightened public interest.
West Nile virus cases in the US are rising with a 1275% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 106 cases per week in the latest week.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are rising with a 66% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 271 cases per week in the latest week.
Hepatitis A cases in the US are at baseline with a 14% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 16 cases per week in the latest week.
Group A strep Wikipedia readership is rising, with 56% of the past year's readership.
US malaria cases are rising, with 38 cases reported weekly (up 52% from 8 months ago), though Wikipedia readership is very low.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are stable at 4,519 per week, with Wikipedia readership at the 21st percentile of the past year.
US RSV hospital admissions are rising, with 1,233 cases reported weekly (up 42% from the previous month).
US whooping cough cases are rising, with 380 cases reported weekly (up 50% from 8 months ago).
US chikungunya cases are stable at 6 per week, with Wikipedia readership very low.
Typhoid fever Wikipedia readership is at the 43rd percentile of the past year.
